title_sq: Zyre per shitje ne zemer te Bllokut
description_sq:
Ofrojme zyre per shitje ne zemer te bllokut ne nje ndertese te re me ashensor.
Organizohet ne tre ambiente te ndara me xham dhe lehtesisht e modifikueshme ne open space.
Ka nje orientim e tera perendim duke siguruar drite gjate gjithe dites dhe shtrihet ne nje siperfaqe neto prej 140 metrash.
Zyra ofrohet teresisht e mobiluar si ne foto.
Per me shume ndiqni videon.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: Sales office in the heart of the Block
description_en: We offer an office for sale in the heart of the block in a new building with an elevator. It is organized in three rooms separated by glass and easily modifiable in open space. It has an all-west orientation providing light throughout the day and extends over a net surface of 140 meters. The office is offered fully furnished as in the photo. For more, watch the video. Has regular mortgage documentation.
